description: This PHP source file contains utility functions for session handling, string processing, configuration retrieval, date/time conversions, network address resolutions, and device type detection. It supports various aspects of device management and network configuration within the web UI of a device firmware, including session-based mode checks, parameter extraction, time zone adjustments, and network address management.
